item.title: Svelte affected by XSS in SSR element

item.title: wcmatch: Polynomial-time ReDoS when matching untrusted names against multi-star patterns (default flags)
item.description: Summary With default flags, a pattern that contains several wildcards takes polynomial time, O(n^k) for k stars, to reject a crafted file name. The pattern is an ordinary developer constant such as .csv ; only the string being matched comes from the attacker. A 255-byte file name (the maximum on common filesystems) takes 73 s with fnmatch.fnmatch() and 86 s with glob.globmatch() . The standard library's fnmatch…

item.title: svglib: Exponential resource consumption via nested references in svg2rlg
item.description: Summary svg2rlg() expands references without any limit on the total number of expansions. Only direct cycles are rejected ( CircularRefError ). A group containing N elements that point to another such group multiplies the work by N per nesting level, so an SVG of about 1.4 KB makes svglib clone and render over 100,000 nodes, taking tens of seconds of CPU time and hundreds of MiB of memory. Each additional level…
